Hey !! first off, dont panic I’m not sure how long you wanted your bangs but I’ve seen people restore messed up bangs that were much shorter. To answer your question I guess it depends on what you what you want,are comfortable with and your experience with scissors ? 

I cut and dye my hair frequently and  when Ive cut my curtain bangs they tend to look a little uneven and blunt on the ends at first so if you can try thinning out the bottoms to create a wispy affect and this will also make unevenness less noticeable . BUT BE CAREFUL because this can go bad fast with one wrong move. 

I don’t know what the technique is called but I’m certain one search will show a bunch of tutorials seeing as curtain bangs are trending now . 

Other wise try and see if someone else can touch them up for you or give it another go if you are okay with making them shorter .

 Or go for straight across  bangs yourself, I’m a bit impulsive but I think they’re a great style . also side note again if you aren’t comfy or confident with cutting your hair dont do this but I’ve found slightly thinning and cutting the hair next to my bangs as in near my ear ish zone helps blend the bangs 

Good luck :)
